summary: Iteration 2 focused testing of 4 new features on top of iteration_1's green base: (a) Emergent-managed Google session coexisting with JWT, (b) Console email reminder pipeline, (c) Trip Memories (photo/note/list/image/delete + auth), (d) Settlement proof upload/fetch. Backend: 9/9 new-feature tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py — including invalid google session_id→401, mongo-seeded session_token accepted as Bearer AND session_token cookie, expired session→401, logout deletes session record, JWT login+/me still intact, garbage bearer→401, reminder emails logged to db.email_log for registered debtors AND for members with no user account, memory photo upload returns storage_path, note create, list returns both kinds, /memories/{id}/image returns bytes, outsider→403, .txt upload→400, DELETE by creator soft-deletes, settlement proof: 404 before upload, upload returns proof_path, GET returns image bytes. Iteration_1 regression suite: 23/23 still passing on rerun. Frontend (playwright, headed on preview URL): (1) /auth Google button is enabled; clicking navigates through https://auth.emergentagent.com/?redirect=<origin>/dashboard (captured via request event before Emergent's own redirect to accounts.google.com). Email/password login still works. (2) /dashboard#session_id=fake shows [data-testid=auth-callback-loading] then redirects to /auth (fake session correctly rejected). (3) TripDetail Memories tab: caption + set_input_files on memory-file-input renders memory-card with photo (naturalWidth>0); memory-note-input + memory-note-btn adds a note card; hover + memory-delete-btn soft-deletes and card count drops (1→2→1). (4) Balances tab: settle-mark-btn opens settle-dialog with settle-note-input + settle-proof-input; settle-confirm-btn creates settlement; settlement-history-item shows view-proof-btn; clicking opens proof-dialog and the BlobImage renders (green 48x48 PNG loaded, naturalWidth=48). Only transient issue observed: intermittent ConnectTimeout on preview ingress (~6/32 tests during one bulk run) — every retry passed; identical to iteration_1's noted infra flake.

minor.issue: Same transient ConnectTimeout (15s) on ~10-20% of calls flagged in iteration_1 — not an application bug; retries always succeed.

critical_code_review_comments: auth.get_current_user falls through to user_from_session on ANY jwt.InvalidTokenError — including malformed JWTs. In practice this is fine but any malformed JWT triggers a mongo lookup on user_sessions.session_token. Consider distinguishing session tokens (not JWTs) at the header level (e.g. length/prefix check) to skip the JWT decode attempt, or vice versa.
auth.google_session stores expires_at as an ISO string; user_from_session parses it defensively — this works but a real datetime with a TTL index on user_sessions would auto-cleanup expired rows.

routers_memories.upload_image reads file.filename to derive extension without null-check on extension → truncated to 5 chars is fine, but an attacker-supplied 'foo.png\x00.exe' would only ever land as .png anyway; still, restrict ext to a whitelist matching content_type to avoid path issues.

routers_trips.send_reminder now emails debtor unconditionally; if from_m.email is malformed we still write it to db.email_log without validation. Add basic email format check before logging or emit `status=skipped_invalid_email`.
email_service.send_email logs full html body to db.email_log for every reminder — this can grow unboundedly. Add a TTL index or trim `html` field length in the db copy.

routers_memories.get_memory_or_404 wraps ObjectId conversion in try/except and returns 400 — good; but memory_image does not fall through to 404 when the underlying object_storage GET fails (bubbles as 500). Consider mapping storage NotFound to 404.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (Google redirect + AuthCallback fake-session + Memories CRUD + Settlement proof upload/view)

seed_data_creation: Test-created rows are all prefixed TEST_/TESTUI_ or ghost_ for easy cleanup: a Trip 'TESTUI_MemProof_<ts>' with aarav+meera, a 2000₹ Dinner expense, 1 photo memory (deleted), 1 note memory, 1 settlement (₹1000) with green PNG proof. New user_sessions rows are deleted in each test's finally block. Also seeded: TEST_Iter2_Trip_<hex> + memories + proof, ghost member ghost_<hex>@nowhere.test, ephemeral outsider TEST_outsider_* users via /register.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_new_features.py uses pymongo (sync) — do NOT switch to motor because pytest-xdist workers share event loops badly. Existing pytest.ini pins -n 2 loadscope so each class runs on one worker; keep it. Preview ingress ConnectTimeout is real infrastructure flake — always retry once. The Google-button click was verified by watching page.on('request') for 'auth.emergentagent.com' BEFORE the page finished following redirects to accounts.google.com — do not assert on page.url after >1s or you'll see the Google host. memory-file-input has class='hidden' so use wait_for_selector(state='attached') then set_input_files.
rca_of_the_issue: No application defects for the new-feature scope. The one 'failure' during isolated rerun (TestTrips::test_settle_zeros_balance) is an in-suite ordering dependency (already documented in iteration_1): the test requires TestTrips::test_add_equal_expense to have run in the same module beforehand. Under `-n 2 --dist loadscope` this always holds because the class is pinned to a single worker; only ad-hoc reruns of just that test in isolation fail — expected.
